CDW Corporation
does not typically sell or distribute specialized clinical-grade wearable medical devices (such as prescription heart monitors or continuous glucose monitors). However, through
CDW Healthcare
, they distribute general consumer smartwatches/fitness trackers and supply the IT integration infrastructure, remote patient monitoring systems, and command centers that aggregate data from medical endpoints.
Products and Solutions Provided
Consumer Wearables:
They sell commercial smartwatches and fitness bands (like Samsung Galaxy and Garmin devices) which feature basic biometric tracking.
CDW
IT Infrastructure:
They supply the backend software, secure networks, and hardware required to route data from remote patient monitoring tools.
Command Centers:
They implement clinical care command systems that centralize incoming data feeds from patient endpoints and wearable sensors.
If you are planning a
remote patient monitoring program
or looking for

CDW Corporation provides enterprise-grade IT infrastructure, mobile device integration, and secure data networks that power [CDW Healthcare Remote Patient Monitoring](https://www.cdw.com/content/cdw/en/industries/healthcare-technology/patient-room-next.html) and [CDW Smart Care Continuum](https://www.cdw.com/content/cdw/en/industries/healthcare-technology/smart-care-continuum.html) solutions for hospitals, clinics, and senior care facilities. [](https://www.cdw.com/content/cdw/en/industries/healthcare-technology/smart-care-continuum.html)

- **Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM):** CDW builds the secure backend architecture, cloud platforms, and EHR (Electronic Health Record) data pipelines that allow health systems to ingest and analyze continuous biometric streams from off-site patients. [](https://www.cdw.com/content/cdw/en/industries/healthcare-technology/smart-care-continuum.html)

- **Clinical Command Centers:** They deploy infrastructure to centralize continuous data feeds—such as heart rate, SpO2, and device telemetry—into unified dashboards for acute care intervention. [](https://www.cdw.com/content/cdw/en/industries/healthcare-technology/patient-room-next.html)
